searchText: Hi all, I have a question regarding the `committee_bits` on Sepolia. I queried some slots after Electra Fork and the `committee_bits` of the attestation within is always `0x0100000000000000`, i.e., only the index `0` committee has attested. Does this has something to do with the formation of validators on Sepolia? Since the sepolia validator set is so small all the validators fit in committee index `0` 🙂
